column1: # ZAP Baseline Rules — FoodWaste Backend
# Format: <rule_id>  <IGNORE|WARN|FAIL>  <optional_comment>
# Full rule list: https://www.zaproxy.org/docs/alerts/
# Rules are set to IGNORE only when:
#   (a) they are confirmed false-positives for NestJS/REST APIs, OR
#   (b) they are handled at the infrastructure layer (nginx, CDN)
# Everything else defaults to WARN (report but don't fail the build).
# Set critical issues to FAIL when you are ready to enforce them as gates.
# ── False-positives for JSON REST APIs ────────────────────────────────────
# "Absence of Anti-CSRF Tokens" — REST APIs use JWT/cookie auth, not form tokens.
# CSRF is handled by our custom CsrfGuard on state-changing endpoints.

column3: REST API - CSRF handled by CsrfGuard + SameSite cookies

column1: # "CSP: Wildcard Directive" — only applies to HTML responses; API returns JSON.

column3: REST API - no HTML content served

column1: # "X-Content-Type-Options Header Missing" — set by Helmet in main.ts.
# ZAP may not see it on /health endpoints which bypass some middleware.
# ── Infrastructure-layer headers (handled by nginx/CDN, not NestJS) ───────
# "Permissions-Policy Header Not Set" — set at reverse-proxy level.
# "Server Leaks Version Information via 'Server' Header"

column3: Hide server version in nginx config
